header.title: How to Replace a Ceramic Stove Top
header.description: This guide provides a simple walkthrough on how to replace a damaged ceramic stove top with a new one. Follow these steps to safely remove the old top and install the replacement.

steps.description: Contact the stove manufacturer to purchase a replacement ceramic stovetop for a guaranteed fit.
actions: Check if your stove is in the warranty period.

steps.description: This step involves carefully removing the damaged stovetop by unscrewing it and handling the broken pieces with caution.
actions: Locate the four screws in the corners of the ceramic stovetop.
Unscrew the damaged stovetop very carefully.
Remove the fragmented section by unscrewing the necessary screws.
Be careful about the broken edges.

steps.description: Break the ceramic stovetop into smaller pieces and wrap them for disposal.
actions: Break the large ceramic stovetop slab into small pieces.
Wrap the small pieces in an old towel or rag.

steps.description: This step involves cleaning the frame, aligning, and securing the new stovetop using screws.
actions: Place the new ceramic stovetop in place
Use the screwdriver to screw it in place
Clean the top with a dry piece of cloth or sponge
